accepted.quote: This bill would provide investors and our capital markets less information about fixed income products traded in the over-the-counter (OTC) markets, and unduly ties the hands of the SEC to address potential investor harms related to fixed income securities.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the bill for reducing market information and constraining SEC investor-protection authority.
